outfits.name: Base (swimwear)
outfits.prompt: A compact, solidly built young man with warm bronze-brown skin, a square strong jaw softened by a short neatly kept dark beard, and a small faded scar just above his left eyebrow. His thick wavy dark brown hair is cropped close on the sides and left longer on top, swept back in a natural finger-combed style. His deep warm brown eyes are round and calm. He wears dark navy swim trunks ending mid-thigh in a quick-dry fabric, a plain muted olive cotton crew-neck t-shirt, and a faded khaki canvas field jacket with rolled-up sleeves shrugged loosely over his shoulders, left unzipped and hanging open. On his feet are worn but clean white canvas low-top sneakers with no socks. He stands with his weight shifted onto one leg, one hand pushed into the jacket pocket, the other hanging loose at his side, shoulders settled slightly forward, chin tilted down just a fraction as if quietly sizing up the scene.
